brief:
Israeli occupation forces have erected earth barriers behind the closed iron gates at Badiah roundabout east of Jenin, the Ma'an news agency reported. The roundabout remains sealed off, with the newly installed soil barriers adding another layer of obstruction.

The measures appear aimed at reinforcing existing closures in the area. The sealed gates and added fortifications restrict movement through the roundabout, a key intersection in the region.
title: Israeli forces install earth barriers at sealed Badiah roundabout east of Jenin
